EmailTemplate.description: General Case Management Template for Sun Devil Card Services
EmailTemplate.name: Case Mgmt | Sun Devil Card Services Photo Approved-Need Form
EmailTemplate.subject: RE: {!Case.Subject}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Contact.FirstName},
We did receive your photo submission and it was approved, an email was sent to your ASU email address but it may have gone to your junk mail. At this point you need to submit a request for your card.
If you would like to pick up your card at one of our on-campus locations, please submit a Pickup Form. https://cfo.asu.edu/webform/basic-sun-card-office-pick-form
If you would like to have your card mailed to you, please submit a Mail Request Form. https://cfo.asu.edu/campus-id-card-request-form
After we have processed your request, we will send you a confirmation email. If applicable, a fee of $25.00 will be applied to your student account within the next few business days.
Regards, {!User.FirstName} {!User.LastName}
Sun Devil Card Services Arizona State University Phone: 480-965-2273 cardservices.asu.edu
If you have any additional information or questions related to this, please reply to this email.
{!Case.Thread_Id}
